images.title: Old Bakery - 23 rue des Francs-Bourgeois, Paris
images.author: Poulpy
images.street: 21 rue de Sévigné / 23 rue des Francs-Bourgeois, 4e arrondissement, Paris
images.shows: corner shopfront with full carved-and-gilded wood boiserie, painted decorative panels, and period boulangerie/patisserie signage still in place under later shop occupancy — frontal, well lit, whole facade legible

images.title: Porte cochère du 26 rue de la Tombe-Issoire octobre 2021
images.author: Artvill
images.shows: single carriage door (porte cochère), dead-frontal, full height with stone surround and arch, street furniture (wheelie bin, delivery van) beside it giving a legible scale reference for the door as the absolute-scale ruler

images.title: Hôtel particulier, porte cochère, 3ème arrondissement, Paris (PH82110) — annotated print reads "Hôtel d'Equevilly, 60 rue de Turenne", Février 1902
images.author: Jean Barry, photographe (Commission municipale du Vieux Paris)
images.shows: period (1902) documentary photograph of a pedimented stone porte cochère on a hôtel particulier, with a pedestrian figure for scale; mildly oblique street view and mounted archive print with border/annotations visible, not a clean crop

images.title: BoulangerieFB2 — painted/gilded glass (verre églomisé) corner panels of a Marais shopfront
images.author: Oderik
images.street: Marais, Paris (exact address not given in source description)
images.shows: close detail of painted-and-gilded decorative glass panels on a shopfront corner pier — good evidence for the surface decoration/lettering feature, but it is a tight detail crop, not the whole facade

images.title: Devanture Boulangerie 159 rue Ordener
images.author: KoS
images.shows: full corner boulangerie shopfront, dead-frontal, dark-blue painted woodwork with gilt lettering, painted glass panels, full storefront glazing down to a panelled base — whole facade legible

images.title: Devanture églomisée 20050917 — Boulangerie, rue de la Roquette corner
images.author: Roby
images.street: corner of rue de la Roquette, Paris
images.shows: corner boulangerie, dead-frontal, green marble-clad base, gilt raised lettering signboard, awning, full storefront glazing — clean full-facade shot

images.title: Devanture de la maison Hébrard, 8 rue Royale, 8ème arrondissement, Paris (PH23412)
images.author: Charles Lansiaux, photographe
images.shows: period photograph of a luxury foundry/gallery shopfront on rue Royale with a sculpted stone lintel relief (Bourdelle) over full-height glazed shop windows and applied bronze lettering — dead-frontal, whole facade legible

images.title: Comptoir Général de Brosserie, 6 rue de Vaucouleurs, Paris
images.author: Jeanne Menj
images.shows: plain painted timber shopfront with hand-painted signage and a folding steel security grille pulled across the glazing — good example of a modest, unrestored shopfront with its original ironwork shutter

images.title: Detail of the facade of an old bakery at Emilio-Castelar street and Charenton street in Paris
images.author: Lionel Allorge
images.street: corner of rue Emilio-Castelar and rue de Charenton, 12e arrondissement, Paris
images.shows: corner boulangerie shopfront ("Boulangerie Viennoise"), dead-frontal, dark marbled base, painted glass corner panels, full storefront glazing and cafe-style outdoor tables — whole facade legible

images.title: PARIS, Brasserie Cyrano, Boulevard de Clichy — postcard postmarked 1912
images.author: Scanné par LeRapon83 (postcard publisher unattributed)
images.street: 82 Boulevard de Clichy (Place Blanche), 18e arrondissement, Paris
images.shows: period (postmarked 1912) postcard view of a grand brasserie's full ground-floor frontage — glazed arcade, awnings, applied lettering, crowded terrace with period cars/carriages for scale — directly documents the observation-date idea; image is a printed/halftone reproduction rather than a photographic original and is moderately oblique

images.title: Paris 75010 Passage du Marché - 2016-01-09
images.author: Guilhem Vellut
images.shows: row of two adjoining ground-floor shopfronts on a narrow passage — one an ornate red-and-gold "Confiseur" boutique, one a plain grilled/shuttered unit — dead-frontal, good comparison of shopfront finish levels side by side

notes: Selected 11 of ~240 Commons search results after filtering out interiors, food-display close-ups, night/dark shots, and oblique courtyard views. Porte cochere coverage is 2 images (one modern, one dated 1902 archive photo) rather than the ideal 3-4 clean frontal doors; Commons search for 'porte cochere' alone returned mostly book scans and PDFs. Construction/build years are left blank throughout except where a date is explicitly documented in the source (1902 archive photo caption; 1912 postcard postmark) -- do not treat facade photography dates (e.g. 2005, 2010, 2016) as building construction dates. Two images (04 and 07) are tight details rather than full facades; marked accordingly via quality/shows fields.
